<html lang="es">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Nuevas Farmacias Escuela</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Montserrat:wght@500;700;800;900&family=Lato:wght@400;700&display=swap">
<style>
:root{
  --navy:#002D72; --cyan:#0097D8; --blue:#4893B8;
  --bg:#F3F7FB; --surface:#FFFFFF; --ink:#0B1F3F; --muted:#4F6280; --line:#D8E3EF;
  --chip:#E6F3FB; --chip-ink:#00558A; --hero-ink:#FFFFFF;
  --hero:linear-gradient(160deg,#002D72 0%,#003C8F 60%,#0068B0 100%);
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){
  :root:not([data-theme="light"]){
    color-scheme:dark;
    --bg:#07152B; --surface:#0E2244; --ink:#E8F0FA; --muted:#9FB3CF; --line:#1F3A63;
    --chip:#12345F; --chip-ink:#7FCBF0; --cyan:#27AEE8;
    --hero:linear-gradient(160deg,#001B47 0%,#002D72 70%,#004A8C 100%);
  }
}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{
  color-scheme:dark;
  --bg:#07152B; --surface:#0E2244; --ink:#E8F0FA; --muted:#9FB3CF; --line:#1F3A63;
  --chip:#12345F; --chip-ink:#7FCBF0; --cyan:#27AEE8;
  --hero:linear-gradient(160deg,#001B47 0%,#002D72 70%,#004A8C 100%);
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font:16px/1.55 Lato,system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;margin:0}
h1,h2,h3,.num{font-family:Montserrat,system-ui,sans-serif;text-wrap:balance;margin:0}
.wrap{max-width:1080px;margin:0 auto;padding-inline:20px}
.eyebrow{font:700 12px/1 Montserrat,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase}

/* HERO */
.hero{background:var(--hero);color:var(--hero-ink);padding-block:44px 56px;overflow:hidden;position:relative}
.hero .eyebrow{color:#7FD3F7}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(32px,6vw,58px);font-weight:900;line-height:1.02;margin-top:14px;max-width:14ch}
.hero h1 span{color:#5CC6F2}
.lead{font-size:clamp(16px,2vw,19px);max-width:58ch;margin:18px 0 0;color:#D6E6F7}
.date{display:inline-flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;margin-top:22px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.22);border-radius:999px;padding:8px 16px;font:700 14px Montserrat,sans-serif}
.date i{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#5CC6F2;display:block}

.total{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:14px;margin-top:40px}
.total .num{font-size:clamp(72px,12vw,120px);font-weight:900;line-height:.85;letter-spacing:-.03em}
.total div{font:800 16px/1.15 Montserrat,sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;padding-bottom:6px}

.countries{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:14px;margin-top:28px}
.country{all:unset;box-sizing:border-box;cursor:pointer;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);border-radius:16px;padding:18px 18px 16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;transition:background .2s,transform .2s,border-color .2s}
.country:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.16);transform:translateY(-2px);border-color:#5CC6F2}
.country:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #5CC6F2;outline-offset:3px}
.country .top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center}
.country svg{width:26px;height:26px;fill:#5CC6F2}
.country .num{font-size:clamp(40px,6vw,54px);font-weight:900;line-height:1}
.country .name{font:800 15px Montserrat,sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em}
.country .go{font-size:13px;color:#BFD9F0;margin-top:4px}
.country .go b{color:#fff}

/* PIONERAS */
.pioneer{padding-block:48px 8px}
.pioneer-box{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:28px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:24px}
.pioneer .eyebrow{color:var(--cyan)}
.pioneer h2{font-size:clamp(22px,3vw,30px);font-weight:800;color:var(--ink);margin-top:10px}
.pioneer p{color:var(--muted);margin:12px 0 0;max-width:52ch}
.pstats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(220px,1fr));gap:12px;align-items:start}
.pstat{background:var(--chip);border-radius:14px;padding:16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
.ph{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:10px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding-bottom:10px}
.plist{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px}
.plist li{background:var(--surface);color:var(--ink);border-radius:999px;padding:4px 10px;font-size:14px}
.pstat .num{font-size:38px;font-weight:900;color:var(--chip-ink);line-height:1}
.pstat .ph span{display:block;font:700 12px Montserrat,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}

/* DIRECTORY */
.dir{padding-block:48px 64px}
.dir-head{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;gap:16px}
.dir-head .eyebrow{color:var(--cyan)}
.dir-head h2{font-size:clamp(24px,3.4vw,34px);font-weight:800;margin-top:8px}
.tabs{display:flex;gap:6px;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:5px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.tab{all:unset;cursor:pointer;padding:9px 16px;border-radius:999px;font:700 14px Montserrat,sans-serif;color:var(--muted);display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center}
.tab em{font-style:normal;font-size:12px;background:var(--chip);color:var(--chip-ink);border-radius:999px;padding:2px 8px}
.tab[aria-selected="true"]{background:var(--navy);color:#fff}
.tab[aria-selected="true"] em{background:rgba(255,255,255,.18);color:#fff}
.tab:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--cyan);outline-offset:2px}

.tools{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-top:22px}
.summary{color:var(--muted);font-size:15px}
.summary b{color:var(--ink);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.search{position:relative;flex:0 1 300px;min-width:0}
.search input{width:100%;font:15px Lato,sans-serif;padding:11px 14px 11px 38px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--surface);color:var(--ink)}
.search input:focus{outline:2px solid var(--cyan);border-color:transparent}
.search svg{position:absolute;left:12px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);width:16px;height:16px;stroke:var(--muted);fill:none;stroke-width:2}

.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(230px,1fr));gap:14px;margin-top:18px}
.card{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:16px 16px 14px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;animation:rise .35s ease both}
.card-h{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding-bottom:10px}
.card-h h3{font-size:15px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.04em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--navy)}
:root[data-theme="dark"] .card-h h3{color:#7FCBF0}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]) .card-h h3{color:#7FCBF0}}
.card-h span{font:700 12px Montserrat,sans-serif;color:var(--muted);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.stores{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px}
.stores li{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:baseline;font-size:15px}
.stores li::before{content:"";width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--cyan);flex:none;transform:translateY(-2px)}
.stores mark{background:#FFE58A;color:#0B1F3F;border-radius:3px;padding:0 2px}
.empty{color:var(--muted);margin-top:22px}

footer{border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-block:24px;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px}
footer .wrap{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px}


.hero-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.15fr .85fr;gap:24px;align-items:center}
.map-box{position:relative;max-width:100%}
.map{width:100%;height:auto;display:block;max-height:560px}
.map .land{fill:rgba(255,255,255,.12);stroke:rgba(255,255,255,.28);stroke-width:.6}
.map .fe{fill:#1A86CF;stroke:#9AD9F7;stroke-width:.8;cursor:pointer;transition:fill .2s}
.map .fe:hover,.map .fe.on{fill:#27AEE8}
.map .pin{cursor:pointer}
.map .pin:focus-visible{outline:none}
.map .pin:focus-visible .drop{stroke:#fff;stroke-width:2}
.map .drop{fill:#FFFFFF;stroke:#002D72;stroke-width:1.2;stroke-linejoin:round;transition:transform .2s;transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:bottom center}
.map .pin:hover .drop{transform:scale(1.12)}
.map .pnum{font:900 22px Montserrat,sans-serif;fill:#FFFFFF;paint-order:stroke;stroke:#002D72;stroke-width:4px}
.map-hint{text-align:center;font-size:13px;color:#BFD9F0;margin-top:6px}
@media (max-width:760px){.hero-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.map-box{max-width:360px;margin:8px auto 0}}
.soon{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font:700 11px Montserrat,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;background:rgba(255,255,255,.14);border-radius:999px;padding:4px 10px;color:#fff}
.soon .lk{width:12px;height:12px;fill:#fff}
.tab em.lock{display:inline-flex;padding:3px 6px}
.tab em.lock .lk{width:12px;height:12px;fill:currentColor}
.locked{grid-column:1/-1;background:var(--surface);border:1px dashed var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:40px 20px;text-align:center;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.locked .lk{width:36px;height:36px;fill:var(--cyan)}
.locked h3{font-size:20px;font-weight:800}
.locked p{color:var(--muted);margin:0}
@keyframes rise{from{transform:translateY(6px)}to{transform:none}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}}
@media (max-width:760px){
  .pioneer-box{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .countries{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .country{flex-direction:row;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:4px 14px}
  .country .top{order:2}
  .country .num{order:1;min-width:2.3ch}
  .country .name{order:3;flex:1}
  .country .go{order:4;flex-basis:100%;margin-top:0}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<header class="hero">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="hero-grid"><div>
    <div class="eyebrow">Capacitación · Vicepresidencia de RR.HH.</div>

    <div class="date"><i></i><span id="fecha">Venezuela: vigentes a partir del 7 de octubre de 2026</span></div>

<path class="drop" d="M-14-13L0-27L14-13H10V0H3V-8H-3V0H-10V-13Z"/>
<text class="pnum" data-num="ar" y="22" text-anchor="middle">0</text></g></svg><div class="map-hint">Toca un país para ver sus Farmacias Escuela</div></div>
    </div>

    <div class="countries" id="countries"></div>
  </div>
</header>

<section class="pioneer">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="pioneer-box">
      <div>
        <div class="eyebrow">Reconocimiento</div>
        <h2>Gracias a las primeras Farmacias Escuela certificadas</h2>
        <p>Reconocemos el esfuerzo y el compromiso de los equipos que abrieron el camino. Su trabajo fue la base para que hoy la red crezca en los tres países.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="pstats" id="pioneers"></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="dir" id="directorio">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="dir-head">
      <div>
        <div class="eyebrow">Directorio</div>
        <h2 id="dirTitle">Farmacias Escuela por área</h2>
      </div>
      <div class="tabs" role="tablist" id="tabs"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="tools">
      <div class="summary" id="summary"></div>
      <label class="search" for="q">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"/><path d="M20 20l-4-4"/></svg>
        <input id="q" type="search" placeholder="Buscar tienda o área" autocomplete="off">
      </label>
    </div>
    <div class="grid" id="grid"></div>
    <p class="empty" id="empty" hidden>No encontramos tiendas ni áreas con esa búsqueda. Prueba con el nombre de la tienda o el número del área.</p>
  </div>
</section>

<footer>
  <div class="wrap">
    <span>Farmatodo · Capacitación</span>
    <span>La red de Farmacias Escuela puede ajustarse según nuevas aperturas.</span>
  </div>
</footer>

<script>
/* ===== DATOS: edita aquí para actualizar ===== */
const OFFICIAL = { ve: 81, co: 34, ar: 4 };          // cifras del mapa
const LOCKED = { co: true, ar: true };               // países bloqueados hasta nuevo aviso
const PIONEERS = {                                   // primeras certificadas
  ve: ["Luis","Delta","Adelmira","La Esquina","Gabriel","Siete Colinas","Kavac","Coral","Sambil La Candelaria 2","Gregorio"],
  co: ["Rodadero","El Prado Santa Marta","Sierra Nevada","Golf","Plaza del Parque"],
  ar: ["Soria","Alesel","Las Heras"]
};
const COUNTRIES = {
  ve: { name: "Venezuela", areaLabel: "Área", areas: {
    1:["Luzmar","Mucura","Teo","Tobogán"],
    2:["Eleanor","Sambil La Candelaria 2"],
    3:["La Maternidad","Zona Franca"],
    4:["Autana","Esmeralda","Expreso","José Miguel","Zafiro"],
    5:["Corina","Granate","Jennifer","La Joya","Nellys"],
    6:["Adelmira","Amatista","Valle de la Pascua","Delta","Luis","Gregorio","Miguel"],
    7:["Bambú","Cielo","Ginebra","Guataparo","La Isabelica","Yadira"],
    8:["Araure","Gisela","Meyby","Omega","Servando"],
    9:["Acerina","El Bosque","Enso","Ónix"],
    10:["Costa Lago","La Esquina","Francisco","Fuerzas Armadas","Nérida","Oro Negro","Cumbres"],
    11:["Escalante","Gabriel","Hernán de Jesús","Los Arbolitos","Salas","Siete Colinas","Soraya"],
    12:["Arabella","Los Cerezos","Marías","Milagros","Tunantal","Pampatar","La Asunción"],
    13:["Coral","Kavac","Anita","Miramontes","Orinoco","Palma Real","Porvenir"],
    14:["Aguamarina","Elizabeth","Jade","Oro","Villa Granada"],
    15:["Scarlet","Aconcagua","Marfil"],
    16:["Los Arenales","Las Salinas","El Samán","Manglar","Estrella Marina"]
  }},
  co: { name: "Colombia", areaLabel: "Área", areas: {
    1:["Cajicá","Mazurén"],
    2:["Bella Suiza","Calle 100","Rincón Chico"],
    3:["Primavera Urbana","Pasadena"],
    4:["Hayuelos","Salitre"],
    5:["CC Ensueño"],
    6:["El Recreo","Manga","Plaza Campestre","Plaza del Parque","San Martín"],
    7:["El Prado Santa Marta","Golf","Rodadero","Sierra Nevada","Villa Country"],
    8:["San Mateo","Sotomayor","Avenida 0","Carrera 27"],
    11:["La Sebastiana","Llano Grande","Milla de Oro"],
    12:["Laureles"]
  }},
  ar: { name: "Argentina", areaLabel: "Área", areas: {
    1:["Soria","Alesel"],
    2:["Las Heras"],
    3:["Botánico"]
  }}
};
/* ============================================ */

const PIN = '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 2L1.5 12H5v10h5.5v-6h3v6H19V12h3.5z"/></svg>';
const $ = s => document.querySelector(s);
const norm = s => s.normalize("NFD").replace(/[̀-ͯ]/g,"").toLowerCase();
const count = k => Object.values(COUNTRIES[k].areas).reduce((a,b)=>a+b.length,0);
let current = "ve";

document.querySelectorAll(".pnum").forEach(t=>t.textContent=OFFICIAL[t.dataset.num]);
$("#total").textContent = $("#leadTotal").textContent = Object.values(OFFICIAL).reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0);
const LOCK = '<svg class="lk" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M7 10V7a5 5 0 0 1 10 0v3h1a1 1 0 0 1 1 1v9a1 1 0 0 1-1 1H6a1 1 0 0 1-1-1v-9a1 1 0 0 1 1-1zm2 0h6V7a3 3 0 0 0-6 0z"/></svg>';

$("#countries").innerHTML = Object.keys(COUNTRIES).map(k=>`
  <button class="country" data-k="${k}" aria-label="Ver Farmacias Escuela de ${COUNTRIES[k].name}">
    <div class="top">${PIN}${LOCKED[k]?'<span class="soon">'+LOCK+'Próximamente</span>':''}</div>
    <div class="num">${OFFICIAL[k]}</div>
    <div class="name">${COUNTRIES[k].name}</div>
    <div class="go">${LOCKED[k] ? 'Listado disponible próximamente' : Object.keys(COUNTRIES[k].areas).length+' '+COUNTRIES[k].areaLabel.toLowerCase()+'s · <b>Ver tiendas →</b>'}</div>
  </button>`).join("");

$("#pioneers").innerHTML = Object.keys(PIONEERS).map(k=>`
  <div class="pstat"><div class="ph"><div class="num">${PIONEERS[k].length}</div><span>${COUNTRIES[k].name}</span></div>
    <ul class="plist">${PIONEERS[k].map(n=>`<li>${n}</li>`).join("")}</ul></div>`).join("");

$("#tabs").innerHTML = Object.keys(COUNTRIES).map(k=>`
  <button class="tab" role="tab" id="tab-${k}" data-k="${k}">${COUNTRIES[k].name}${LOCKED[k]?'<em class="lock">'+LOCK+'</em>':'<em>'+count(k)+'</em>'}</button>`).join("");

function hl(name,q){
  if(!q) return name;
  const i = norm(name).indexOf(q);
  if(i<0) return name;
  return name.slice(0,i)+"<mark>"+name.slice(i,i+q.length)+"</mark>"+name.slice(i+q.length);
}

function render(){
  const c = COUNTRIES[current];
  const q = norm($("#q").value.trim());
  document.querySelectorAll(".tab").forEach(t=>t.setAttribute("aria-selected", t.dataset.k===current));
  document.querySelectorAll(".map .fe").forEach(p=>p.classList.toggle("on", p.dataset.k===current));
  $("#dirTitle").textContent = `Farmacias Escuela en ${c.name}`;
  $(".search").hidden = !!LOCKED[current];
  if(LOCKED[current]){
    $("#grid").innerHTML = `<div class="locked">${LOCK}<h3>Muy pronto</h3><p>Las Farmacias Escuela de ${c.name} se publicarán en los próximos días.</p></div>`;
    $("#empty").hidden = true;
    $("#summary").innerHTML = "";
    return;
  }
  let shown = 0, areasShown = 0;
  const isNum = /^(area\s*)?\d+$/.test(q);
  const html = Object.entries(c.areas).sort((x,y)=>Number(x[0])-Number(y[0])).map(([a,list])=>{
    let f = list;
    if(q){
      if(isNum) f = q.replace(/\D/g,"")===String(a) ? list : [];
      else f = norm("area "+a).includes(q) ? list : list.filter(s=>norm(s).includes(q));
    }
    if(!f.length) return "";
    shown += f.length; areasShown++;
    return `<article class="card">
      <div class="card-h"><h3>${c.areaLabel} ${a}</h3><span>${f.length} ${f.length===1?"tienda":"tiendas"}</span></div>
      <ul class="stores">${f.map(s=>`<li>${hl(s,q)}</li>`).join("")}</ul>
    </article>`;
  }).join("");
  $("#grid").innerHTML = html;
  $("#empty").hidden = shown>0;
  $("#summary").innerHTML = `<b>${shown}</b> Farmacias Escuela en <b>${areasShown}</b> ${c.areaLabel.toLowerCase()}${areasShown===1?"":"s"}`;
}

function select(k, scroll){
  current = k; render();
  try{ localStorage.setItem("fe-country",k) }catch(e){}
  if(scroll) $("#directorio").scrollIntoView({behavior: matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches ? "auto":"smooth"});
}

document.addEventListener("click", e=>{
  const b = e.target.closest(".country,.map [data-k]"); if(b) return select(b.dataset.k,true);
  const t = e.target.closest(".tab"); if(t) return select(t.dataset.k,false);
});
$("#q").addEventListener("input", render);
document.querySelectorAll(".pin").forEach(p=>p.addEventListener("keydown",e=>{if(e.key==="Enter"||e.key===" "){e.preventDefault();select(p.dataset.k,true)}}));

const hashMap = {venezuela:"ve",colombia:"co",argentina:"ar"};
let start = hashMap[location.hash.slice(1)];
if(!start){ try{ start = localStorage.getItem("fe-country") }catch(e){} }
current = COUNTRIES[start] && !LOCKED[start] ? start : "ve";
render();
</script>
</body>
</html>
